notes: Single-file HTML double wishbone suspension simulator. Canvas 2D rendering with three views (front/side/3/4). Rigid lines (wishbones, upright, tie rod), deformable line (kingpin path), and nodes (ball joints). Features: suspension travel simulation with camber gain, steering tie rod linkage, kingpin axis visualization with motion path, real-time readout of camber/caster/toe/KPI/trail/scrub radius. Industrial software style UI, no emojis/rounded corners/shadows.
